tensions.claim_a: A source that previously passed calibration deserves continued authority
tensions.claim_b: A scoped independent calibration failure removes authority for that case regardless of prior certification

commitments: Keep authorship verification separate from factual reliability
When a scoped calibration failure is authenticated, suspend the source's authority for that case class pending re-calibration
Do not let a signature substitute for a calibration record in route decisions.
